title: Smuggled cigarettes: NBI files cases against 13 people over ₱13B haul

blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has filed criminal complaints against at least 13 individuals over the alleged smuggling of 59 cargo containers of foreign cigarettes worth ₱13 billion. The complaints are for violations of the Agricultural Economic Sabotage Act. NBI-7 Assistant Regional Director Arnel Pura said that the Cebu office contributed to the investigation by handling the confiscation of the shipments at a private wharf in Mandaue City and securing affidavits from witnesses.
